title: DESIGN THINKING AND PROCESS INNOVATION
description: Application of a qualitative, multi-method approach to gain insight into how the consumer experience can be improved within a given context. Application of design thinking principles to identify and develop solutions to improve consumer experience within a given context.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
